post.description: Public endpoint. Rejects existing confirmed or unconfirmed email accounts with 409 after a server-side Auth Admin lookup. That lookup requires SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY; ordinary Auth requests use the public key. With email confirmation enabled and the DAYLI Confirm signup template installed, sends a six-digit signup code. A pending confirmation returns session null; call /auth/verify-otp with the email and code. No profile is created until successful verification or verified login. Never persists passwords.

post.summary: Verify a six-digit signup email code
post.description: Public endpoint; no bearer token required. Accepts email and a six-digit ASCII token string, including leading zeros. Calls Supabase verifyOtp with type signup. Returns a verified session and provisions the own profile/default preferences through the existing transaction. Invalid, expired or reused codes return 401; malformed input returns 422; provider rate limits return 429. Never stores or logs the code.

post.summary: Resend a signup email verification code
post.description: Public endpoint; accepts email only, without a bearer token. Uses Supabase resend with type signup and the existing Confirm signup email template. Returns a generic accepted response for unconfirmed, confirmed or absent accounts; only unconfirmed accounts receive mail. Does not create an account, profile or session. Provider rate limits return 429 with Retry-After when available; invalid input returns 422, provider rejection 400, and provider/connectivity failures 502/503.

post.summary: Create own commitment or weekly rule
post.description: Requires bearer token and profile. ONCE requires offset-aware start/end. WEEKLY requires first date, local whole-second endpoints, day offset and IANA timezone; optional ISO weekday must match first date. Overnight uses offset 1. No Task is created. Example: {"title": "Lecture", "category": "STUDY", "start_at": "2026-11-16T09:00:00Z", "end_at": "2026-11-16T10:00:00Z"}.
